co2_creep.name: co2_creep
co2_creep.title: Cabin CO₂ creep
co2_creep.story: Cabin CO₂ and related performance signals gradually move from this simulated crew member’s own baseline.
expected_events: Mission day 22: the approved co2_creep effects begin at the existing scenario onset.
Mission days 22–29: CO₂ and linked performance effects ramp over eight days; a rule alert is possible, not guaranteed.
co2_creep.label: simulated

sleep_debt.name: sleep_debt
sleep_debt.title: Accumulating sleep debt
sleep_debt.story: Sleep duration, efficiency, reaction lapses, and mood follow the existing simulated sleep-debt effects.
expected_events: Mission day 22: the approved sleep_debt effects begin at the existing scenario onset.
Mission days 22–26: sleep effects ramp over five days; downstream impairment alerts are possible, not guaranteed.
sleep_debt.label: simulated

sensor_loss.name: sensor_loss
sensor_loss.title: Sensor dropout
sensor_loss.story: Two simulated sensors stop publishing at the existing sensor-loss onset so the core’s stale-data handling is visible.
expected_events: Mission day 22: resting_hr_bpm and rmssd_ms readings stop in the generated stream.
After the configured stale interval: the core may mark those signals stale; exact status timing is governed by contract thresholds.
sensor_loss.label: simulated
